newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HERMIS BANK TO SIGN $10 MILLION LOAN WITH RZB.
newsitem.headline: HERMIS BANK TO SIGN $10 MILLION LOAN WITH RZB.

text.p: Lithuania's Hermis Bank said late on Monday that it will sign a $10 million syndicated loan agreement with Austria's Raiffeisen Zentralbank Osterreich Aktiegesellschaft (RZB) this week.

The chairwoman of Hermis Bank, Nadiezhda Novickiene, is expected to sign the deal during a European road show the bank is giving to drum up investors for the its planned global depository receipts (GDR) issue, The bank said in a statement.
"The rapidly increasing capital of the bank and the needs of clients for loans make it necessary to increase borrowing," the statement said.
Hermis Bank said on June 23 that it had signed an agreement with the investment bank Williams de Broe to distribute eight million litas of its new share issue as GDRs by August 1.
The shares are the remaining portion of a 23 million litas share issue, 65 percent of which was bought by its current shareholders last month.
